biography: Eric Graham, born in the shadow of the Le Mans circuit, practically breathed gasoline fumes from infancy. His grandfather, a mechanic for a privateer team in the '70s, instilled a deep love for motorsport in him. Eric's journey began in karting, where his defensive style quickly became apparent – an unyielding wall for anyone attempting an overtake. He recalls one particularly rainy race at the age of 15, where, despite being significantly slower than his rivals, he held off a pack of five karts for the entire final lap, earning a surprise victory. This tenacity earned him a scholarship to a prestigious racing academy, and from there he steadily climbed the ranks, eventually landing a seat with Lamborghini. Though he's shown flashes of brilliance, consistency has been his Achilles' heel. Currently, Graham is fighting to retain his seat with Lamborghini, hoping to prove he has what it takes to compete at the highest level.
drivingStyle: Graham is known for his incredibly defensive driving style. He prioritizes track position and maximizing the width of his car, making overtaking him an exercise in frustration. While not the fastest driver in a straight line, he's adept at braking late and positioning his car perfectly to defend corners. He's methodical with tire management, often sacrificing early pace to ensure he has grip in the closing stages of a race. Under pressure, he tends to become even more conservative, focusing on avoiding mistakes rather than taking risks.
rivalries: Marco Bellini - A long-standing rivalry stemming from a controversial incident in Formula 3 where Bellini accused Graham of deliberately blocking him, costing him the championship.

Isabelle Dubois - A fierce on-track battle for position during a particularly wet race led to both drivers crashing out. Graham blamed Dubois for aggressive driving, igniting a feud that continues to this day.
Kenji Tanaka - Tanaka, known for his aggressive overtaking maneuvers, constantly tries to force passes on Graham, testing Graham's defensive resolve to its limit.
quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of socks, gifted to him by his grandfather, for every race.
Listens to classical music precisely one hour before the race to calm his nerves.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about being the fastest; it's about being the smartest and making your opponents earn every inch."
careerHighlight: Winning the Spa 24 Hours in 2020, a grueling endurance race where his consistent pace and defensive driving proved crucial in securing victory for his team.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap of the 2022 Daytona 24 Hours due to a mechanical failure, costing his team a likely victory and earning him considerable criticism.
